data.name: VHS Nights: The Tidy Up Shift
data.detailed_description:
IT'S 1992. YOU NEED A JOB. ANY JOB.

Congratulations. You've just landed a job at your local VHS rental store.

It's not glamorous. It's not well paid. And apparently, the previous employee decided that 1,120 movies didn't need to be organised.

Your shift ends when every tape is in the right place.

Sort movies by genre. Sort them by year. Read the ridiculous blurbs. Keep the shelves tidy.

And whatever you do, don't lose the tape.

📼 1,120 MOVIES. ZERO REPEATS.

A huge collection of fictional VHS movies spanning decades of cinema.

Every movie has its own:

  • 🎬 Unique parody title

  • ⭐ Parody cast

  • 📅 Release year

  • 🎭 Genre

  • 📼 Movie blurb

  • 🗂️ Correct place on the shelf

No two movies have the same title. 

🎞️ 20 VHS GENRES

From big-budget blockbusters to absolute bargain-bin garbage:

ACTION • MARTIAL ARTS • HORROR • SCI-FI • COMEDY • ROMANCE • THRILLERS • CRIME • FANTASY • ADVENTURE • WESTERNS • MONSTERS • CULT CLASSICS • FAMILY • TEEN HITS • MUSIC & DANCE • SPORTS • IMPORTS & ANIME • DOCUMENTARIES • HOLIDAY FAVORITES

⏪ BE KIND. PLEASE REWIND.

Sorting isn't the only thing you'll be doing.

Customers return tapes without rewinding them, because apparently that's your problem now.

Keep the store running, get through your shift and deal with whatever disasters turn up along the way.

🕹️ GET BETTER AT THE JOB

The more you play, the more capable you become.

Unlock new abilities that help you sort faster, manage the store and deal with the increasingly ridiculous workload.

What starts as a simple job becomes a race against the clock to become the ultimate VHS sorting machine.

YOUR SHIFT HAS STARTED.

1,120 TAPES.
20 GENRES.
DECADES OF MOVIES.
ONE VERY TIRED EMPLOYEE.

Now get sorting.

data.short_description: It’s 1992 and the VHS store is counting on you! Sort 1,120 unique movies by genre and year with no title repeated twice. A true sorting game for movie lovers! Discover hilarious parody titles and blurbs, unlock abilities, and enjoy optional tape rewinding.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
